name: Shalt Cornish
original_name: シャルト＝コーニッシュ
source:
A woman who is a nimble and dexterous thief. With an easygoing and friendly manner, she is skilled at making a living. She is a member of a magician guild.

At the beginning of the events of Thief & Sword, she is dispatched by the guild to reclaim a stolen grimoire.

In the wake of that incident, she became focused on dealing with troubles involving chimeras and human trafficking.
